Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art character atlas for a Python dress-up game. Create ORIGINAL early-2000s Japanese fashion doll pixel art, detailed clean black pixel outlines, softly shaded fabric folds, expressive anime eyes, beautiful cohesive pastel/Y2K aesthetic. NOT a UI screenshot. TRANSPARENT background. NO text, grids, labels, logos, shadows, props or background.
Create EXACTLY 12 full-body characters arranged in an EXACT uniform grid of 6 columns x 2 rows. Landscape canvas, recommended 3072 x 2048, every cell same size. Each cell contains ONE doll, full body including hair and shoes, strictly front-facing in IDENTICAL neutral pose, hands down close to hips, feet slightly apart. Do not overlap cells. All dolls must have exactly the SAME height and body proportions, head top at 6% cell height, neck at 29%, waist at 51%, ankles at 91%, shoe soles at 97%. Heads centered horizontally in each cell, waist centered, feet positions identical. Figure width about 53% cell width. Keep head, shoulders, waist and ankles EXACTLY aligned across every column so horizontal strips can be mixed and matched into new outfits. About 4.5 heads tall, adult young fashion dolls, cute but not children. Faces fully detailed.
TOP ROW: SAME young adult woman with fair warm skin, large brown eyes, dark brown shoulder-length hair, same face and hair in all 6 cells.
Column 1: mint puff-sleeve blouse, long cream pleated skirt down to ankles, dainty black high heels.
Column 2: white short-sleeve T-shirt, loose blue straight jeans, white sneakers.
Column 3: white collared business blouse, charcoal fitted trousers, dark brown leather loafers.
Column 4: rose pink long evening dress with fitted waist and flowing floor-length skirt, silver high heels.
Column 5: lavender athletic tee, fitted black athletic leggings, purple running sneakers.
Column 6: butter-yellow sleeveless sundress with skirt to knees, brown flat sandals.
BOTTOM ROW: SAME young adult man with fair warm skin, large brown eyes, short dark brown hair, same face and hair in all 6 cells. Same overall height/pose/waist position as female row.
Column 1: cream knitted sweater, dark blue jeans, brown leather shoes.
Column 2: lavender short-sleeve T-shirt, beige cargo trousers, white sneakers.
Column 3: white collared business shirt, charcoal tailored trousers, polished black leather shoes.
Column 4: navy suit jacket over white shirt and tie, navy suit trousers, black formal leather shoes.
Column 5: blue athletic tee, black athletic shorts to knees, white running sneakers.
Column 6: mint linen short-sleeve shirt, beige shorts to knees, brown sandals.
All 12 characters must be anatomically consistent and precisely aligned within their cells. Hair stays above the neck boundary at 29% so torso strips can change independently. Arms do not extend below waist. Transparent pixels around every doll. Actual sharp pixel art, not blurry or painterly. Beautiful garment detail at game-sprite scale.
background_extraction_attempt: Edit this character atlas for production game use. Remove the entire colored blurry backdrop and ALL floor shadows, leaving genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the twelve characters, including gaps between arms/body and legs. Keep all 12 character designs, facial details, garment details, poses, positions and canvas size EXACTLY unchanged. Do not redraw or move characters. Transparent background, no checkerboard drawn into pixels, no new background colors. This is a precise background extraction.
final_pixel_edit: Re-render the attached twelve-character atlas with these TWO required technical changes: 1) EVERY BACKGROUND PIXEL must be the exact SAME solid light pink color #fff7fb. No gradient, no vignette, no floor, no shadows, no glow, no checkerboard, no transparency. A single flat solid color. 2) Render characters as authentic low-resolution 1990s/2000s pixel doll sprites, crisp stair-stepped 1-pixel dark outlines and 4-color fabric shading, roughly 100 pixels wide by 240 pixels tall per character, nearest-neighbor enlarged. Not smooth painterly illustration. Preserve the 6-column by 2-row arrangement, all twelve garments/characters, the facial features, poses and overall character positions. All characters need the identical horizontal shoulder/waist/ankle alignment as the others in their row for dress-up mixing. No text or other elements.
